title: Airbnb Reviews

startUrls.title: Airbnb URLs
startUrls.description: Airbnb listing URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/12345678) or search URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/s/Lisbon--Portugal/homes?room_types[]=Entire home/apt): a search URL harvests the reviews of every listing it returns, up to maxListingsPerQuery, with its filters kept. Use for "reviews of this listing". A URL from another site is rejected before anything is charged. Default empty.
startUrls.sectionDescription: Point at listings directly, or at a place and let the run find them. At least one of the three.

listingIds.title: Listing ids
listingIds.description: Numeric Airbnb listing ids, e.g. ["11562247", "45307024"] (the number in /rooms/<id>): the fastest input when the listings are known — your portfolio, a comp set. A listing named twice (id and URL, or id and place) is harvested and billed once. Default empty.

locationQueries.title: Places
locationQueries.description: Places as typed on Airbnb, e.g. ["Lisbon, Portugal"], ["Algarve"]: the reviews of every listing Airbnb returns for the place, up to maxListingsPerQuery. A place Airbnb does not recognise is reported as an unknown_area status row and costs nothing. Use for "Airbnb reviews for a city", competitor and market research.

maxListingsPerQuery.title: Max listings per place
maxListingsPerQuery.description: Listings to take from each place or search URL before harvesting their reviews, 1 to 280, e.g. 50 (default 20). The bill for a place is at most maxListingsPerQuery × maxReviewsPerListing reviews. Ignored for listingIds and listing URLs.

maxReviewsPerListing.title: Max reviews per listing
maxReviewsPerListing.description: 0 = every review the listing has (Airbnb pages them 50 at a time; 300 from one listing verified). N = the first N in reviewsSort order, e.g. 20 (default 100). The main cost control: $0.005 per review delivered. The free listing row's reviews_total says how many exist.
maxReviewsPerListing.sectionDescription: How many reviews per listing, in what order, and which ratings to keep: this is where the bill is decided.

reviewsSort.title: Order
reviewsSort.description: Which reviews come first: "most_recent" (default, the one to schedule), "highest_rated", "lowest_rated" (complaints first), "most_relevant" (Airbnb's own order). Use "lowest_rated" with minRating for a complaints feed.

minRating.title: Only reviews at or below this rating
minRating.description: 0 (default) = keep every review. 1 to 5 = keep only reviews rated AT OR BELOW this star rating, e.g. 3 for "negative reviews" (1, 2 and 3 stars). Reviews above it are dropped before billing: a 441-review listing returned 4 rows under minRating 3. Use with reviewsSort "lowest_rated".

locale.title: Language
locale.description: Language for Airbnb's translations (text_localized), e.g. "en" (default), "es", "fr", "de", "pt", "it", "ja". Every row also carries the original text and the language it was written in. Use for "reviews translated into Spanish".
locale.sectionDescription: Translations and the free per-listing row.

includeListingRow.title: Include a listing row
includeListingRow.description: true (default) = also emit one free listing row per listing with name, URL, reviews_total and reviews_fetched, so you can see how many reviews exist. false = review and status rows only. Never charged.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings; required, Airbnb blocks datacentre traffic that is not rotated. Keep the default {"useApifyProxy": true}.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (egress IPs), 1 to 16, e.g. 4 (default 4). Each is paced at perIp requests per second; more sessions = a faster run at the same cost.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3, e.g. 1 (default 1). Airbnb tolerates about 1 per second per IP; raise it only when a run is slow and not being throttled.

description: Airbnb reviews. Minimal input: {"listingIds": ["11562247"], "maxReviewsPerListing": 50}. One of listingIds / startUrls / locationQueries is required. The bill is listings × maxReviewsPerListing at $0.005 per review (default 100 per listing; 0 = every review); minRating 3 keeps only reviews rated 3 or below and bills only those.
